title: Editor crashes on exit while regenerating script documentation
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: v4.8.dev2.official [7220d45], v4.7.1.stable.official [a13da4f], v4.6.3.stable.official [7d41c59c4]

### System information

Godot v4.6.3.stable - macOS Sequoia (15.7.5) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Metal (Mobile) - integrated Apple M2 Max (Apple8) - Apple M2 Max (12 threads) - 64.00 GiB memory

### Issue description

Running the editor with `--import` on a project with many scripts crashes with `SIGSEGV` on exit while the script documentation is still being regenerated.

It is a race, so it does not crash on every run. Adding `--headless` makes it disappear completely (0/5 runs); the documentation is not regenerated in that case.

Backtrace from a `dev_build=yes` build of master [51105ccbe]:

```
handle_crash: Program crashed with signal 11
Engine version: Godot Engine v4.8.dev.custom_build (51105ccbe58381774ecd7a7486d564b202a5192e)

[1] _sigtramp + 56
[2] std::__1::__atomic_base<unsigned long long, false>::load[abi:nn200100](std::__1::memory_order) const (__atomic/atomic.h:67)
[3] CowData<char32_t>::_ref(CowData<char32_t> const&) (./core/templates/cowdata.h:546)
[4] CowData<char32_t>::CowData(CowData<char32_t> const&) (./core/templates/cowdata.h:228)
[5] CowData<char32_t>::CowData(CowData<char32_t> const&) (./core/templates/cowdata.h:228)
[6] String::String(String const&) (./core/string/ustring.h:677)
[7] String::String(String const&) (./core/string/ustring.h:677)
[8] EditorFileSystemDirectory::get_file(int) const (editor/file_system/editor_file_system.cpp:100)
[9] EditorFileSystemDirectory::get_file_path(int) const (editor/file_system/editor_file_system.cpp:132)
[10] EditorHelp::_reload_scripts_documentation(EditorFileSystemDirectory*) (editor/doc/editor_help.cpp:3290)
[11] EditorHelp::_reload_scripts_documentation(EditorFileSystemDirectory*) (editor/doc/editor_help.cpp:3286)
[12] EditorHelp::_reload_scripts_documentation(EditorFileSystemDirectory*) (editor/doc/editor_help.cpp:3286)
[13] EditorHelp::_reload_scripts_documentation(EditorFileSystemDirectory*) (editor/doc/editor_help.cpp:3286)
[14] EditorHelp::_reload_scripts_documentation(EditorFileSystemDirectory*) (editor/doc/editor_help.cpp:3286)
[15] EditorHelp::_regen_script_doc_thread(void*) (editor/doc/editor_help.cpp:3275)
[16] Thread::thread_callback(void*) (drivers/apple/thread_apple.cpp:57)
```

### Steps to reproduce

1. Extract the MRP.
2. Import the project once. Note there is no `--headless` in any of these commands.

```bash
godot --path . --import
```

3. Repeat the following a few times. Most runs print
   `handle_crash: Program crashed with signal 11` (3/5 runs on v4.7.1.stable.official).

```bash
rm -f .godot/editor/editor_script_doc_cache.res
godot --path . --import
```

Deleting the cache is what makes the documentation be regenerated on every run: the cache is written back at exit whenever it was loaded or regenerated successfully, so a run that survives leaves a cache behind and the next run does not regenerate at all.

The MRP contains 1500 trivial scripts spread over 150 directories. The script count is what keeps the regeneration running until the editor exits, and spreading them over many directories makes the crash happen far more often than a flat layout does. `generate_scripts.py` regenerates them if you want to change the size.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[script-doc-regen-exit-crash-mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30776428/script-doc-regen-exit-crash-mrp.zip)
